#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CLI with pyproject.toml configuration support using cyclopts."""

from pathlib import Path
from cyclopts import App

# Create sample pyproject.toml if it doesn't exist
sample_toml = """[tool.mycli]
name = "World"
count = 2
verbose = false
"""

config_file = Path("pyproject.toml")
if not config_file.exists():
    config_file.write_text(sample_toml)

# Create app with TOML config support
app = App(
    config_search_paths=["pyproject.toml"],
)

@app.default
def main(
    name: str = "",
    count: int = 1,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """
    Greeting CLI with pyproject.toml configuration.
    
    Configuration is read from [tool.mycli] in pyproject.toml.
    Command-line arguments override configuration file values.
    """
    for _ in range(count):
        print(f"Hello, {name}!")
        if verbose:
            print("  (verbose mode enabled)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
